wch2025_straight_minus_200m_same_athlete.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): the same athletes' RT on the home-straight start minus their RT on the 200 m start at WCH2025 (sign-flipped from the probe's 200 m minus straight; positive = straight start slower)

straight_minus_200m_same_athlete_other_m.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): smallest same-athlete straight-minus-200 m difference among the other 7 championships with such athletes
EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): largest same-athlete straight-minus-200 m difference among the other 7 championships with such athletes

wch2025_straight_lane_gradient_ms_per_la.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): RT gradient across lanes on the home-straight start at WCH2025 (outer lanes slower), within race

wch2025_outer_minus_inner_lanes_ms.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): WCH2025 home-straight start: lanes 7-9 minus lanes 1-5, athlete-adjusted RT

wch2022_to_2023_median_minus_p5_shift_ms.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): WCH2022 to WCH2023: change of the athlete-adjusted median RT minus change of its 5th percentile (0 = the whole distribution shifted uniformly)

wch2022_faster_rounds.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): rounds (first round, semi-final, final) in which WCH2023 minus WCH2022 is positive with a CI excluding 0, i.e. WCH2022 faster

wch2022_faster_start_types.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): start types (home straight, 200 m) whose athlete-adjusted median RT rose from WCH2022 to WCH2023 with a CI excluding 0, i.e. WCH2022 faster

wch2022_days_faster_than_every_2023_day.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): WCH2022 competition days whose athlete-adjusted mean RT is below that of every WCH2023 day

same_athletes_2022_to_2023_change_ms.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): mean change in RT of the same athletes from WCH2022 to WCH2023 (athletes with valid starts at all three recent World Championships)

same_athletes_2023_to_2025_change_ms.desc: EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): mean change in RT of the same athletes from WCH2023 to WCH2025 (athletes with valid starts at all three recent World Championships)
